summary: Variants can tune result depth to risk while retaining a common evidence envelope.

items.text: Require every quality-gate agent to emit the same verdict, evidence, confidence, waiver and remediation fields.
Render a compact top-level verdict from a richer machine-readable analysis report rather than duplicating evidence.
Use a fast lane for low-risk green results and escalate suspicious or conflicting packets into an evidence-deep review track.
Display provenance, model, provider, tools and policy decisions as expandable trust layers beside the result.
